releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.49 standardizes the Smart Life header across Home, Files, Notes and Library. Price Photos now supports local product categories, category filtering and category management without adding a new app tab. Adding a product now detects an exact existing barcode before creating a copy and warns about possible duplicate names, while allowing legitimate same-name products to be saved. Existing Price Photos automatically remain available as Uncategorized, and deleting a category never deletes its products. The v0.11.48 Library/Inbox merge and v0.11.47 Instagram save/Gallery flow are preserved.
